newsitem.title: ECUADOR: IADB head Iglesias backs Ecuador austerity plans.
newsitem.headline: IADB head Iglesias backs Ecuador austerity plans.

text.p: Inter-American Development Bank (IADB) head Enrique Iglesias Friday declared support for government plans to impose austerity measures to cut the country's bduget deficit.

"Ecuador has some problems with the budget deficit which the government has to face up to. I think that it is taking the necessary measures and in the next few weeks there will be announcements," Iglesias told reporters in Quito, where he is assessing the country's economy.
Iglesias said that government officials had informed him of some measures to cut the deficit which are due to be announced Monday, but declined to say what they were.
"I think that Ecuador has a chance of significant improvement in the future," he said.
He said that the IADB does not make policy recommendations to governments.
The $1.3 billion deficit is equivalent to 6.6 percent of Ecuador's gross domestic product.
The government has refused to reveal details of Monday's austerity announcements, but official sources told Reuters that increases in the prices of fuels and domestic gas are being studied.
